properties.displayName: AuditLogs - Connect Sync Application Change Detected
properties.description: Detects changes to the Microsoft Entra Connect Sync provisioning application, including changes to its configured credentials on Microsoft Entra ID
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where ingestion_time() > ago(5m)
| where tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName) startswith "ConnectSyncProvisioning_"
| where OperationName has_any ("Add service principal", "Add application", "Update application", "Certificates and secrets management")
| mv-expand modifiedProperties = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties
| where tostring(modifiedProperties.displayName) == "KeyDescription"
| extend oldValue=tostring(modifiedProperties.oldValue), newValue=tostring(modifiedProperties.newValue)
| extend
    oldValueCount=array_length(extract_all(@"DisplayName=([^\]]+)", dynamic([1]), oldValue)),
    newValueCount=array_length(extract_all(@"DisplayName=([^\]]+)", dynamic([1]), newValue))
| where newValueCount != oldValueCount
| extend SourceUser=tostring(coalesce(Identity,InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName,InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId)),App=tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| extend  SourceUserId = tostring(coalesce(InitiatedBy.user.id,InitiatedBy.app.id)), UpdatedUserPrincipalName = tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName), SourceIP=tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress) 
| where SourceUser != App
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    SourceUser,
    SourceIP,
    SourceUserId,
    OperationName,
    App,
    oldValue,
    oldValueCount,
    newValue,
    newValueCount,
    Message=strcat(coalesce(SourceUser,SourceUserId),' perfomed ',tolower(OperationName),' operation on ',App, ' from ',SourceIP),
    CorrelationId
